text: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) acquired a 33% stake in the Azimut|Benetti Group in 2023, with the Vitelli family retaining the majority stake.

source.name: SuperyachtNews: PIF becomes minority shareholder of Azimut Benetti
